# F12-R

Synthetic signed v4 integration record; no real account or claimed authentication. The in-memory non-extractable P-256 private key was discarded when construction ended. Only the public key, signed payload and signature are retained.

Returns are exactly F12's stored integers. Dates are consecutive calendar month ends, 2024-01-31 through 2025-03-31.

The existing verifier accepted schema, signatures, chain and arithmetic. effectiveStamps(profile) yields exactly one slot. Its schedule is insufficient_observations; SPEC-03 §6.3 maps this to schedule_compatible=true. The input and oracle expectation concern only that derived unsigned statistics view.
